# Module Reference

This page documents all Terraform modules in the repository. Each module creates
a complete resource with all associated permissions and grants.

## How Module Documentation Works

Each module directory contains a `README.md` with auto-generated documentation
produced by [terraform-docs](https://terraform-docs.io/). The pre-commit hook
updates these READMEs on every `git push`, keeping them in sync with the code.

```
snowflake/modules/snowflake_database/
├── main.tf           Module resources
├── variables.tf      Input variables (with descriptions)
├── outputs.tf        Output values (with descriptions)
└── README.md         Auto-generated by terraform-docs
```

The auto-generated READMEs contain full input/output tables with types, defaults,
and descriptions. This page provides context, purpose, and cross-references
between modules.

## AWS Modules

### `s3_bucket`

Creates an S3 bucket with versioning, encryption, lifecycle policies, and optional
public access blocking.

**Location**: `aws/modules/s3_bucket/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `bucket_name` | `string` | Name of the S3 bucket |
| `environment` | `string` | Environment tag (dev, staging, prod) |
| `enable_versioning` | `bool` | Enable object versioning |
| `lifecycle_rules` | `list(object)` | Object lifecycle and expiration rules |

**Used by**: Data lake buckets (dev, staging, prod), Terraform state bucket

### `vpc`

Creates a VPC with public and private subnets across two availability zones,
NAT Gateway, route tables, and optional VPC endpoints.

**Location**: `aws/modules/vpc/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `vpc_cidr` | `string` | CIDR block for the VPC |
| `availability_zones` | `list(string)` | AZs for subnet distribution |
| `enable_nat_gateway` | `bool` | Enable NAT Gateway for private subnets |
| `enable_vpc_endpoints` | `bool` | Create S3, ECR, and Secrets Manager endpoints |

**Used by**: ECS-hosted services (Prefect, Airbyte, Lightdash, OpenMetadata)

## Snowflake Modules

### `snowflake_database`

Creates a Snowflake database with `DB_READER` and `DB_WRITER` database roles
and all associated grants. Follows the reader access chain pattern.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_database/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `database_name` | `string` | Name of the database (e.g. `DLT`, `AIRBYTE`) |
| `database_comment` | `string` | Description of the database purpose |
| `data_retention_time_in_days` | `number` | Time Travel retention period |

**Outputs**: `database_name`, `db_reader_role_name`, `db_writer_role_name`

**Reader access chain**: `{DB}_DB_READER` is granted to `ANALYTICS_SOURCES_READER`,
which is inherited by analyst roles.

### `snowflake_database_role`

Creates a database role with configurable grants on schemas and objects within
a database.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_database_role/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `database_name` | `string` | Database the role belongs to |
| `role_name` | `string` | Name of the database role |
| `privileges` | `list(string)` | Privileges to grant (SELECT, INSERT, etc.) |

### `snowflake_warehouse`

Creates a warehouse with auto-suspend, auto-resume, scaling policy, and usage
grants to specified roles.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_warehouse/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `warehouse_name` | `string` | Name of the warehouse |
| `warehouse_size` | `string` | Size (XSMALL, SMALL, MEDIUM, etc.) |
| `auto_suspend` | `number` | Seconds of inactivity before suspending |
| `usage_roles` | `list(string)` | Roles granted USAGE on the warehouse |

**Instances**: `LOADING`, `TRANSFORMING`, `REPORTING`, `DEVELOPER`

### `snowflake_role`

Creates an account-level role with grants to other roles (role hierarchy).

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_role/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `role_name` | `string` | Name of the role |
| `role_comment` | `string` | Description of the role purpose |
| `granted_roles` | `list(string)` | Roles granted to this role |
| `granted_to_roles` | `list(string)` | Roles this role is granted to |

**Instances**: `ANALYTICS_DEVELOPER`, `ANALYTICS_TRANSFORMER`, `ANALYTICS_REPORTER`,
`ANALYTICS_SOURCES_READER`

### `snowflake_user`

Creates a user with default role, default warehouse, optional dedicated role,
and role grants. Handles admin users, developer users, and service accounts.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_user/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `user_name` | `string` | Snowflake username |
| `user_display_name` | `string` | Display name |
| `user_default_warehouse` | `string` | Default warehouse for the user |
| `user_is_service_account` | `bool` | Whether this is a service account |
| `user_create_dedicated_role` | `bool` | Create a role matching the username |
| `user_additional_roles` | `list(string)` | Extra roles to grant |

**Key behaviour**: When `user_create_dedicated_role = true`, the module creates
a role with the same name as the user (e.g. `SVC_DLT` user gets `SVC_DLT` role).
This role is used for database-level grants.

### `snowflake_schema`

Creates a schema within a database with grants to specified database roles.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_schema/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `database_name` | `string` | Database containing the schema |
| `schema_name` | `string` | Name of the schema |
| `schema_comment` | `string` | Description of the schema purpose |
| `writer_roles` | `list(string)` | Roles with write access |

### `snowflake_storage_integration`

Creates a storage integration for S3 access, including the IAM role trust
relationship configuration.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_storage_integration/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `integration_name` | `string` | Name of the storage integration |
| `storage_allowed_locations` | `list(string)` | S3 paths the integration can access |
| `storage_aws_role_arn` | `string` | ARN of the IAM role for Snowflake to assume |
| `usage_roles` | `list(string)` | Roles granted USAGE on the integration |

**Instances**: `dev`, `staging`, `prod`, `prod_readonly`

### `snowflake_saml2_integration`

Creates a SAML2 security integration for SSO with identity providers
(Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace).

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_saml2_integration/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `integration_name` | `string` | Name of the SAML2 integration |
| `saml2_issuer` | `string` | Identity provider issuer URL |
| `saml2_sso_url` | `string` | SSO login URL |
| `saml2_x509_cert` | `string` | IdP signing certificate |

### `snowflake_snowpipe`

Creates a Snowpipe with stage, file format, pipe, and SQS notification
for automatic S3 ingestion.

**Location**: `snowflake/modules/snowflake_snowpipe/`

| Key Input | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `pipe_name` | `string` | Name of the Snowpipe |
| `database_name` | `string` | Target database |
| `schema_name` | `string` | Target schema |
| `table_name` | `string` | Target table |
| `stage_url` | `string` | S3 stage URL |
| `storage_integration` | `string` | Storage integration for S3 access |
| `file_format` | `string` | Format for ingested files (JSON, CSV, Parquet) |

**Used by**: Exchange rates pipeline (S3 → Snowpipe → SNOWPIPE database)

## Module Relationships

```
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │  snowflake_role │ (ANALYTICS_DEVELOPER, etc.)
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │ granted_to
                    ┌────────▼────────┐
                    │  snowflake_user │ (default_role, warehouse)
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │ dedicated_role (if service account)
               ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
               │             │              │
    ┌──────────▼──┐  ┌───────▼────┐  ┌──────▼───────────────┐
    │  snowflake  │  │ snowflake  │  │ snowflake_storage     │
    │  _database  │  │ _schema    │  │ _integration          │
    └──────┬──────┘  └────────────┘  └───────────────────────┘
           │
    ┌──────▼──────────┐
    │ snowflake       │
    │ _database_role  │ (DB_READER, DB_WRITER)
    └─────────────────┘
```
